# Stage A implementation contract (2026-10-18)

Scope: standalone package only. Existing grid API preserved. No commits/push/deploy. Baseline c829a33 (clean checkout). Plan: docs/plans/blueprint-v2-plan-2026-10-18.md. Coordinator owns this contract, pubspecs, public barrels, Flutter controller/resources and final validation. Each owner must read the plan. Do not run concurrent full builds.

## Frozen v1 seams

Core public barrel: package:venue_layout_core/venue_layout_core.dart.
- `VenueLayoutDocument.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic>)`, `.toJson()`, `.copyWith({List<LayoutNode>? nodes, Map<String,dynamic>? canvas, ...})`; `.nodes` List<LayoutNode>, `.canvas` Map<String,dynamic>, `.sections`, `.selectionUnits`, `.attachments`, `.presets` List<Map<String,dynamic>>, `.background` Map<String,dynamic>?, `.defaultTextStyle` Map<String,dynamic>. Empty factory `VenueLayoutDocument.empty()`.
- `LayoutNode.fromJson(Map<String,dynamic>)`, `.toJson()`, `.copyWith({String? parentId, bool clearParent=false, double? x,y,rotation,width,height, String? label, bool? locked, Map<String,dynamic>? properties})`; `.id`, `.kind`, `.parentId`, `.x/.y/.rotation/.width/.height` double, `.z` int, `.locked` bool, `.label` String, `.properties` Map<String,dynamic> (shape,text,fontId,size,color,etc). JSON transforms per plan; non-common fields flatten into properties. Required constructor `LayoutNode({required String id, required String kind, String? parentId,double x=0,y=0,rotation=0,width=40,height=40,int z=0,bool locked=false,String label='',Map<String,dynamic> properties=const {}})`.
- `String newLayoutId()` UUID v4; `List<LayoutIssue> validateDocument(VenueLayoutDocument)`; issues `.reason/.path/.nodeId`.
- `Map<String,dynamic> compileScene(VenueLayoutDocument document, {Map<String,dynamic> resources=const {}, Map<String,dynamic> presentation=const {}})` display list map `{protocol:1,canvas:...,items:[{id,kind,matrix:[a,b,c,d,e,f],path:[[M|L|C|Q|Z,...]],fill:'#RRGGBBAA',stroke:...,strokeWidth:num, ...}],issues:[]}`. Text glyphs are paths, no runtime text geometry. Image item uses `assetRef`, matrix, width,height,crop,opacity; renderers resolve bytes. Items may include labels/accessibility but no native text rendered in scene. World transforms center-based, quantized 1/1024.
- `String? hitTest(VenueLayoutDocument document,double x,double y)` topmost geometric target; `List<double> worldMatrix(VenueLayoutDocument,LayoutNode)`; `Map<String,double> documentBounds(VenueLayoutDocument)`.
- `VenueLayoutDocument tableLayout({required String shape, int count=6,double x=400,y=300,width=180,height=100,String? id})` returns fragment table+chairs; `VenueLayoutDocument reflowTable(VenueLayoutDocument,String tableId,int count)` retains IDs; `int tableCapacity(LayoutNode)`.
- `VenueLayoutDocument cloneLayout(VenueLayoutDocument,{double dx=0,dy=0})` remaps all references.
- Other generator/fitting APIs core owner adds and documents here before UI use. No geometry duplication in Flutter/JS.

Coordinator Flutter controller: `VenueLayoutController extends ChangeNotifier`, constructor `(VenueLayoutDocument document,{Map<String,dynamic> resources=const {}})`; `document`, `resources`, `Set<String> selection`, `bool canUndo/canRedo/dirty`, `String? error`, `bool readOnly`, `.select(Set<String>)`, `.apply(VenueLayoutDocument,{String label='Edit'}) -> bool`, `.beginGesture()`, `.preview(VenueLayoutDocument)`, `.commitGesture()`, `.cancelGesture()`, `.undo()/.redo()/.markSaved()`, `.insert(VenueLayoutDocument fragment,{double dx=0,dy=0})`, `.deleteSelection()`, `.duplicateSelection()`, `.moveSelection(double dx,double dy)`, `.rotateSelection(double degrees,{bool cornerPivot=false})`, `.updateNode(LayoutNode)`, `.setSeatCount(String tableId,int count)`, `.setResources(Map<String,dynamic>)`. `apply` validates structural integrity while preserving the supplied canvas. Object manipulation never grows the canvas; drafts may overlap, but new or worsened placements beyond the canvas are rejected. Bounded manipulations clamp at the nearest feasible position; legacy out-of-bounds drafts remain repairable. `placementIssues` and `showPlacementWarnings()` identify save-time overlap/boundary problems. Cancelled gestures restore the full document/canvas. `LayoutHistoryParticipant` capture/restore optional registered via `.addHistoryParticipant(...)`.

UI imports public package barrel `package:venue_seat_picker/venue_seat_picker.dart` and Flutter material. UI-owned files `lib/src/layout_editor/widgets/**`. Public `VenueLayoutEditor({required VenueLayoutController controller, Widget Function(BuildContext,LayoutNode)? inspectorBuilder, bool showGallery=true})`, `VenueLayoutViewer({required VenueLayoutDocument document, Map<String,dynamic> resources=const {}, Map<String,dynamic> seatPresentation=const {}})`, `VenueLayoutPicker({required VenueLayoutDocument document,Map<String,dynamic> resources=const {},Map<String,dynamic> seatPresentation=const {},Map<String,dynamic> capacityPresentation=const {},required Future<LayoutSelectionResult> Function(Set<String> nodeIds,bool selecting) onSelectionRequested,Future<LayoutSelectionResult> Function(String,int)? onQuantityRequested})`. Result coordinator defines `LayoutSelectionResult({required bool accepted,String? message})`. Widgets reuse core scene, never invent geometry. UI export paths sent to coordinator.

Templates owner public `LayoutTemplate` `.id/.title/.description/.seatCount/.standingCapacity`, `.create() -> VenueLayoutDocument` new identities. `VenueLayoutTemplates.all`, `.byId(String)`, `.create(String)`; default ball-classic. Files `lib/src/templates/**` owned demo agent. All 9 templates in public package; demo imports them.

JS API exports global VenueLayoutKernel through pure core wrapper with JSON string inputs/outputs: `.decode(json)`, `.validate(json)`, `.compileScene(json,resourcesJson,presentationJson)`, `.hitTest(json,x,y)`, `.interpolate(fromJson,toJson,t)`, protocol getter. JS renderer owner core, `web/src/index.js` public mount/update/dispose with no independent geometry. Demo owner `web/demo/**` only. Coordinator `web/package.json`/manifest/typings unless explicitly handed over.

Resources: glyph map `{fonts:{fontId:{unitsPerEm,ascent,descent,glyphs:{character:{advance,path:[[...]]}}}}}`. Core reports unavailable fonts/glyphs; never substitutes. Demo local resource fixtures to be prepared by coordinator under `assets/layout_fonts/` with licenses. Template texts use `fixture:sans` default, alternate `fixture:serif`.
